reviews.pros: What i appreciate most about working at Larsen & Toubro is the company's strong brand value and reputation in the industry, additionally, the organization ensure timely salary disbursement on the 28th of every month, which reflect its financial discipline and employee-centric approach.
reviews.cons: While L&T offers a strong platform and excellent brand value, there are few areas where improvement is needed, work-life balance is often affected because workload planning is not clearly defined, and employees occasionally face interruptions during weekly offs and leaves. internal approval processes can be time consuming, and the performance evaluation system could be more transparent and objective to ensure fairness for all employees.

I joined the company in 2022 and initially received a decent hike compared to my previous salary. However, I soon realized that the pay and grade were not aligned with what existing employees at the same level were getting. In my department, I was handling responsibilities alone at the site, yet there was no recognition or appreciation during the appraisal cycle. On the other hand, employees who are better at maintaining relationships and “buttering” seniors received good hikes, promotions, and higher PLR, regardless of their actual contribution. This made me feel that career growth here depends more on lateral entry or networking than on performance and dedication. I had joined with the hope of growing quickly through hard work and merit, but the system seems to favor internal politics over genuine effort.
